name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A step-by-step playbook that makes an AI coding assistant stop and ask what you actually want, write a plan you can check, and only then start coding — instead of guessing and sprinting ahead.
buyer: A non-technical founder or product manager who directs AI coding agents and has been burned by an agent building the wrong thing quickly.
business_use_cases: A non-technical founder uses it so their AI coding agent interviews them about requirements before writing any code, avoiding wasted building time.
An engineering lead standardizes the workflow across the team so every AI-assisted feature gets a reviewable spec and plan before implementation.
A consultancy offers 'AI-assisted development done right' as a service built on the methodology, charging for outcomes instead of hours.

money_ideas.idea: Sell enterprise support and managed-spend services for companies adopting the methodology at scale.

steal_this: This weekend, write a one-page 'AI development process' cheat sheet based on the methodology and sell it as a short guide to non-technical founders directing AI agents.
